author: (G. B. Sowerby II, 1851)

note.en: A tiny banded venus clam about 1.5 cm long, listed from Cahuita under its synonym Transennella stimpsoni[^4].
note.es: Una almeja venus diminuta con bandas de cerca de 1.5 cm, registrada en Cahuita bajo su sinónimo Transennella stimpsoni[^5].

evidence: GBIF: 1 INBio specimen (2001), south of Punta Cahuita, recorded as Transennella stimpsoni, a synonym per WoRMS
